Contracts and Service Site Map month is a start-month attribute, not service-month validity. The local template removes their Calendar start-month relationships. Use explicit half-open UTC overlap and project reviewed keys; a March-start mapping can remain valid in July. A separately requested start-month analysis must explicitly select that date role, not imply validity.

No Contracts-to-SLA Evaluation fact relationship is inferred. Filter contract_key explicitly on SLA Evaluation or Applied Credits, the exact home tables of the source measures, using the reviewed cohort. Only the home table's allowed dimensions are legal.
'Service Site Map' is service_key plus valid_from grain; [valid_from,valid_to) defines the serving site and contract. 'Contracts' is effective contract_key grain with its own validity interval.

Use 'SLA Evaluation'[Eligible Credits] and 'SLA Evaluation'[Credit Exposure] from 'SLA Evaluation', and 'Applied Credits'[Applied Credits] from 'Applied Credits'. All are cents by SLA service month and permit contract_key grouping.

'SLA Evaluation' is contract_key plus month grain. 'SLA Evaluation'[Credit Exposure] is source-owned signed eligible less applied cents, without a zero floor. Negative values indicate overapplication, classified INVALID_SETTLEMENT / OVERAPPLIED_CREDITS; never clamp negative residuals or apply a second per-incident cap.
'Service Month'[Contracted Recurring Revenue] on 'Service Month' is contracted recurring service value, not recognized billing revenue; ask for clarification when 'revenue' is unqualified.

An absent Applied Credits posting remains null, distinct from an explicit zero posting; use governed 'SLA Evaluation'[Credit Exposure] for the signed residual. A posting with an unknown amount is INCOMPLETE_SETTLEMENT / MISSING_APPLIED_AMOUNT, not zero or a complete total. Do not sum known residuals into a complete account total when a contract amount is unknown.

Negative applied SLA cents violate this local source settlement contract independently of the residual sign. Validate every applied credit posting's contract_key and half-open contract service-month overlap; never treat 'Applied Credits'[posted_at] as service month.

aiInstructions: Use the source-owned measures and their declared home tables, dimensions and units. Do not replace source calculations with new formulas.
Clarify the metric, population and reporting period when unresolved. A requested date is not evidence of source coverage; do not invent a latest complete period.
Use registered keys and reviewed identity mappings, not display names or coincidentally equal integers. Preserve unknown and excluded mappings.
Missing, partial, stale or denied data is not measured zero or a complete monetary total. Preserve non-additive measures and report coverage limitations.
Keep data, source-model, ontology and context-cache clocks separate. New context does not freshen old source observations.
AI instructions and schema selection are guidance, not permissions or hard enforcement. A local object reference does not prove that an AI consumer exposes that object.
'Cases'[case_key] is case grain; 'Case Activities'[activity_key] is activity grain. Use 'Cases'[New Cases] for case volume, not activity counts.
'Cases'[month] is opening month. 'Cases'[Resolved Cases] counts source-resolved cases attributed to opening month, not a resolution-month flow; clarify a request for resolution-period throughput.
'Cases'[Repeat Contacts] uses the source seven-day, same-account, same-reason definition. 'Cases'[Contacted Accounts] is distinct accounts, not a sum of period-level distinct counts.
Use 'Cases'[First Contact Resolution] with its source resolved-case denominator. Unresolved cases do not become resolved failures or zero-duration observations.
'Cases'[Mean Resolution Hours] is hours among resolved cases; 'Cases'[resolved_at] and 'Cases'[opened_at] remain separate date roles and unresolved durations remain missing.
'Case Daily Snapshot'[Open Cases EOD] uses one observed 'Case Daily Snapshot'[snapshot_date]. Do not sum snapshots over dates or infer continuous observation between snapshots.

Keep case counts at 'Cases'[case_key] grain and activity counts at 'Case Activities'[activity_key] grain; multiple activities per case must not multiply case metrics, and contact volume alone does not establish root cause.
